newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Max in share option deal to boost Intrepid.
newsitem.headline: Max in share option deal to boost Intrepid.

text.p: Max Resources Ltd said on Friday it had appointed a new director to Intrepid Mining Corp NL to seek a South East Asian investment and gain more value from its holding in the Australian gold explorer.
Max said it had also granted him a option on a block of 20 million partly-paid Intrepid shares.
The new director, Jakarta-based Duncan Merrin, had been asked to introduce and oversee "a major new resource opportunity/project in South East Asia for Intrepid," Max said.
"Max is confident that Merrin, via his extensive industry connections, will be able to source a substantial resource project which will significantly benefit Intrepid," it added.

Max currently owns just over 15.6 million fully paid shares in Intrepid in addition to the partly-paid stock covered by the option deal. At a market price of A$0.27 it values this holding at NZ$4.8 million.

Max is altering the essential nature of its group business to that of manufacturing and distributing organic fertiliser, and has therefore been seeking to increase the value of its investment in Intrepid as it considers its future strategy.

"The introduction of an additional highly-prospective resource project to supplement Intrepid's existing projects should increase the value of Intrepid and hence Max's investment in Intrepid," the company said.
